```{r setup}
library(ghg.sp)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(scales)
library(wesanderson)

ggplot2::theme_set(councilR::council_theme(use_showtext = TRUE))
st_paul_pass <- transportation_data$passenger %>% 
  filter(ctu %in% c("St. Paul",
                    "All"),
         # !year %in% c("2045", "2050")
  )
st_paul_freight <- transportation_data$freight %>% 
  filter(ctu %in% c("St. Paul",
                    "All"),
         # !year %in% c("2045","2050")
  )

```


```{r}
st_paul_pass %>% 
  filter(str_detect(var, "Sales"),
         mode == "PLDV",
         var != "TotSales") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = year,
             y = value,
             color = var,
             fill = var,
             group = var)) +
  geom_area(position = "fill") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = wesanderson::wes_palettes$Royal2,
                    aesthetics = c("fill", "color")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent)
```



```{r}
adj_sales <- adj_fleet_shares(.pass_tb = st_paul_pass,
                              .freight_tb = st_paul_freight,
                              .bev_pct_sales = 0.4854,
                              .hev_pct_sales = 0.1352,
                              .phev_pct_sales = 0.3151)
```
```{r}
adj_sales$pass %>% 
  filter(str_detect(var, "Sales"),
         mode == "PLDV",
         var != "TotSales") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = year,
             y = value,
             color = var,
             fill = var,
             group = var)) +
  geom_area(position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = wesanderson::wes_palettes$Royal2,
                    aesthetics = c("fill", "color")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent)
```
